title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-06-02
content:
Release Engineering meeting notes — 2026-06-02
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Diego Ramirez, Priya Singh, Evan Brooks, Sofia Alvarez, written notes by Maya

Agenda:
- Quick sync on active release train (v1.12.x) and schedule for next stable release
- Hotfix status for customer incident (INC-2345) and rollout plan
- Changelog approval and packaging for release notes
- Canary/rollback policy reminders + QA gating items
- Action items and owners

Summary / Decisions:
1) Release train status (v1.12.0 planned for 2026-06-09)
   - Branch: release/v1.12 tracked in REL-1123, cut date still 2026-06-04 EOD unless blockers appear.
   - Feature freeze: in effect. No non-critical changes after branch cut.
   - Canary window: 6 hours at 5% traffic, then 30% for 24 hours before full rollout.
   - Decision: Keep canary progression automated but require manual sign-off for service-facing schema changes (Priya).

2) Hotfix for INC-2345 (HOTFIX-1456/JIRA-HOTFIX-1456)
   - Root cause: race condition in KV-cache invalidation when rolling config update hits older runtime (serving-runtime).
   - Fix implemented in branch hotfix/hf-1456 by Evan. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345
   - Staging: deployed 2026-06-01 19:00, smoke tests green.
   - Production plan: phased rollout starting 2026-06-02 22:00 UTC, 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 3 hours if no errors. Monitoring dashboard: release-hotfix-hf-1456 (logs + 5xx rate, lat p95).
   - Rollback trigger: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for > 15m or lat p95 increase > 30% vs baseline.
   - Decision: proceed with phased rollout tonight. Diego to own monitoring during rollout.

3) Changelog and release notes
   - Draft changelog compiled in confluence page linked: https://confluence.redwood/company/release-train-2026-q2 (Priya drafted initial bullets).
   - Need two customer-facing items: public changelog blurb + migration notes for private deployments (KMS key rotation note).
   - Action: Priya to finalize copy by 2026-06-04. Maya to approve.

4) Canary and rollback policy reminders
   - Reminder: always include feature-flag gating for new runtime opts that touch caching or routing.
   - For model/quantization changes, require extended canary (48h at 30%) and synthetic-eval pass.
   - Action: Sofia to update gating checklist in internal runbook (runbook link in Confluence).

5) Release automation / CI notes
   - Observed intermittent flakes in e2e test suite related to dataset seeding (RA-201). Release pipeline currently reruns failed tests automatically; causing delay and noise.
   - Short term: increase retries to 2 and add jitter to seeding for next pipeline run. Evan to make change in CI config (target: 2026-06-03 morning).

Risks / Blockers:
- Pending: dependency upgrade (openssl) in infra that requires coordinated deploy across dedicated and private clusters. Targeting grace window 2026-06-10. If delayed, may block final rollout for Private customers. (Linked JIRA: INFRA-987)
- Unknown: potential downstream impact of hotfix on telemetry pipeline; engineering-observability to monitor.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego Ramirez — monitor hotfix rollout tonight and report back in #release-notifications (2026-06-03).
- Priya Singh — finalize changelog + migration notes and push to confluence (2026-06-04).
- Evan Brooks — update CI retries/jitter to reduce flakiness; send PR and merge (2026-06-03).
- Sofia Alvarez — update gating checklist & runbook with extended canary rules for quant changes (2026-06-05).
- Maya Chen — verify Private deployment KMS note with Security (2026-06-04).

Notes / Open questions:
- Do we need an emergency communication template for hotfixes that affect Dedicated tenants? (Priya to propose template if required).
- Should we add a preflight telemetry run for every hotfix that touches caching? Proposal deferred to next week — Diego to draft.

Links mentioned / artifacts:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345
- JIRA: REL-1123, HOTFIX-1456, INFRA-987
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/company/release-train-2026-q2
- Slack: #release-engineering, #prod-incident

Next meeting:
- Weekly release sync — 2026-06-09 16:00 UTC (tentative) — focus on post-canary review and infra dependency plan.

Informal notes / rough TODOs (notes-to-self style):
- Double-check telemetry baseline window before rollout (use 72h window).
- Confirm with SRE on rollback playbook steps so Diego has escalation contacts.
- Add a short line to changelog about improved cache invalidation behavior; avoid deep technical details in public blurb.

End of notes.
